[PREFERENCE] User is thinking of offering coffee options during the event.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant stated that a medium roast coffee can be a good choice to pair with Rooibos Chocolate Chai tea.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained that a medium roast coffee provides balance and complementary flavors to the tea.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested that offering both medium and dark roast coffee options would cater to different tastes.  
[PREFERENCE] User plans to offer both medium and dark roast coffee options at the event.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for setting up a tea and coffee tasting station, recommending:  
- Dedicate a separate station for each type of beverage.  
- Use visually appealing displays.  
- Clearly label each tea and coffee option.  
- Provide tasting cups and utensils.  
- Add a water station for palate cleansing.
